# Time

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/view/components/time.h`](../../../src/view/components/time.h) · Described in `data/view.json`

The game calendar of the Time system: seconds since start, speed and pause.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `current` | `dy::time_t (uint64_t)` | game seconds since start |
| `speed` | `dy::time_t` | game seconds per real second (60) |
| `speed_modifier` | `dy::time_t` | 0 (paused), 1, 3, 10, 50 |
| `last_speed_modifier` | `dy::time_t` | the modifier P brings back |
| `dt` | `dy::time_t` | game seconds of this frame (speed x modifier x dt x 10, truncated) |
| `minute / hour / day / month / year` | `static constexpr dy::time_t` | lengths in seconds (28-day months, 4 seasons a year) |

## Notes

Emplaced by Time in preinit. Date (same header) splits a time into years, months (Spring..Winter), days, hours, minutes, seconds for display. No other system reads it: the sky has its own clock (Sky).
